title: Choose a finite checkpoint delay when retries can irreversibly damage the parent
statement: Suppose each identical feed has mutually exclusive probabilities p=eta*q_c*exp(-gamma_c*t), w=eta*q_w*exp(-gamma_w*t), d>0 for correct commit, wrong commit and permanent damage, and all other outcomes restore the same parent. For gamma_w>gamma_c>0 and q_c,q_w,eta>0 with p+w+d<=1, unlimited identical retries give F(t)=p/(p+w+d). Over t>=0 this is maximized at max(0,ln((gamma_w-gamma_c)*eta*q_w/(gamma_c*d))/gamma_w).

requires: Fixed mutually exclusive per-attempt correct/wrong/damage probabilities and valid p+w+d<=1; q_c,q_w,eta,d,gamma_c,gamma_w are declared inputs.
Every nonterminal miss restores the same competent parent without aging or changed probabilities, and unlimited attempts are allowed.
provides: Suppose each identical feed has mutually exclusive probabilities p=eta*q_c*exp(-gamma_c*t), w=eta*q_w*exp(-gamma_w*t), d>0 for correct commit, wrong commit and permanent damage, and all other outcomes restore the same parent. For gamma_w>gamma_c>0 and q_c,q_w,eta>0 with p+w+d<=1, unlimited identical retries give F(t)=p/(p+w+d). Over t>=0 this is maximized at max(0,ln((gamma_w-gamma_c)*eta*q_w/(gamma_c*d))/gamma_w).
assumptions: Per-attempt damage is an exclusive terminal outcome in this mathematical model; do not combine overlapping independent failure events without recomputing the renewal law.
No current actual kinetic measurements, long-time reactor stability or retained-parent experiment supplies these assumptions.
costs: All failed attempts, donor clearing/recovery, chase/reduction and parent damage are charged. Model expected attempt count1/(p+w+d) does not establish physical speed, capped yield or a stable100-step operation.
contract.units: gamma_c,gamma_w use one inverse-time clock; t has corresponding time units; eta,q_c,q_w,d,p,w,F are dimensionless probabilities.
contract.obstruction: Measure a valid physical renewal kernel and finite-time/yield behavior before using the optimizer to design a chemical protocol.

body: First-step conditioning gives F=p+(1-p-w-d)*F. Minimize 1/F-1=(q_w/q_c)*exp(-(gamma_w-gamma_c)*t)+(d/(eta*q_c))*exp(gamma_c*t). This strictly convex sum has its unique unconstrained minimum at the stated logarithm; constrain to t>=0. Positive damage makes the optimum finite and F tends to zero for very long waits. The number of attempts until any terminal outcome has mean1/(p+w+d), but this does not supply missing wash/recovery time or a finite retry cap. Finite capped completion is a different contract. F^L requires identical independent per-stage conditional behavior and an appropriate absorbing failure definition; it is not automatically an actual long-chain yield.
